# aether_clusters (Data Source)

Every cluster of the organization, in the API's order (by id). Includes clusters that are being deleted or have failed, until the platform removes them.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes List) The clusters, with the same attributes as `data.aether_cluster`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `capi_cluster_name` (String) Internal Cluster API name of the cluster.
- `ceph_pool` (String) Storage pool of the cluster.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `endpoint` (String) API server URL, once the cluster is provisioned far enough to report one.
- `harbor_project` (String) Registry project associated with the cluster.
- `id` (String) Cluster UUID.
- `k8s_version` (String) The `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` the platform resolved the cluster's version to.
- `keycloak_realm` (String) Identity realm of the cluster.
- `lb_subnet` (String) Load-balancer subnet allocated at create time.
- `name` (String) Cluster name (unique within the organization).
- `observed_kubernetes_version` (String) Kubernetes version the control plane reports once a rollout settles.
- `plan` (String) Package slug; null when the cluster is billed per resource.
- `public_endpoint` (Boolean) Whether the API server is exposed on a public IPv4 address and DNS name.
- `region` (String) Region id (e.g. `eu-fi`).
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status reported by the API (`provisioning`, `running`, `upgrading`, `degraded`, `failed`, `deleting`, ...).
- `status_message` (String) Human explanation accompanying the status, when the API offers one.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).
- `worker_subnet` (String) Per-cluster worker /24 allocated at create time.
